pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.2: tena kho pana samayena therā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ovadanti pariyāyena. tena kho pana samayena āyasmato cūḷapanthakassa pariyāyo hoti bhikkhuniyo ovadituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.3: bhikkhuniyo evamāhaṃsu nadāni ajja ovādo iddho bhavissati taññevadāni udānaṃ ayyo cūḷapanthako punappunaṃ bhaṇissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.4: athakho tā bhikkhuniyo yenāyasmā cūḷapanthako tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ cūḷapanthakaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.5: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho tā bhikkhuniyo āyasmā cūḷapanthako etadavoca samaggattha bhaginiyoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.9: eso bhaginiyo ovādoti niyyādetvā imaṃ udānaṃ punappunaṃ abhāsi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.14: bhikkhuniyo evamāhaṃsu nanu avocumhā nadāni ajja ovādo iddho bhavissati taññevadāni udānaṃ ayyo cūḷapanthako punappunaṃ bhaṇissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.15: assosi kho āyasmā cūḷapanthako tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.16: athakho āyasmā cūḷapanthako vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā ākāse antalikkhe caṅkamatipi tiṭṭhatipi nisīdatipi seyyaṃpi kappeti dhūmāyatipi pajjalatipi antaradhāyatipi taññeva udānaṃ bhaṇati aññañca bahuṃ buddhavacanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.18: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.19: na vata no ito pubbe ovādo evaṃ iddho bhūtapubbo yathā ayyassa cūḷapanthakassāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.20: athakho āyasmā cūḷapanthako tā bhikkhuniyo yāva samandhakārā ovaditvā uyyojesi gacchatha bhaginiyoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.21: athakho tā bhikkhuniyo nagaradvāre thakkite bahinagare vasitvā kālasseva nagaraṃ pavisanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.22: manussā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti abrahmacāriniyo imā bhikkhuniyo
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.23: ārāme bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ vasitvā idāni nagaraṃ pavisantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.24: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.25: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.26: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā cūḷapanthako atthaṅgate suriye bhikkhuniyo ovadissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.27: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ cūḷapanthaka atthaṅgate suriye bhikkhuniyo ovadasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.30: hi nāma tvaṃ cūḷapanthaka atthaṅgate suriye bhikkhuniyo ovadissasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.32: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.33.1: sammatopi ce bhikkhu atthaṅgate suriye bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:2.1.8: aṭṭhahi vā garudhammehi aññena vā dhammena ovadati āpatti pācittiyassa.
